title: The Sexual Teachings of the Jade Dragon
author: Hsi Lai
description: The Sexual Teachings of the Jade Dragon: Taoist Methods for Male Sexual Revitalization by Hsi Lai, published by Destiny Books (Rochester, Vermont). Presented as the teachings of a lineage of Taoist masters of sexual cultivation, the book explains for a male readership how sexual energy (jing) can be conserved and transmuted into vitality (qi) and spirit (shen) for health, longevity and spiritual growth. It covers the Taoist understanding of yin and yang in sexual relations, ejaculation control and retention, breathing and visualisation methods, exercises for strengthening the reproductive system, and the ideal of reciprocal exchange of energy between partners, set within the wider framework of Taoist internal alchemy and Chinese medicine. A companion to the author's The White Tigress Manual on female practice, it is a modern practical guide to the 'arts of the bedchamber' tradition rather than a scholarly edition of classical texts.
